basic_details.job_title: FSL Delhi Internship 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 75 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL Delhi) is recruiting candidates for 75 vacancies under Intern (Chemistry), Intern (Biology), Intern (Ballistics), Intern (Cyber Forensic) and Intern (Physics/A/V) posts on a contract basis for a period of one year. The engagement carries a stipend of Rs. 30,000 per month. Candidates who have already worked as paid intern in FSL, Delhi shall not be eligible to apply. Applicants must submit the offline application form to the Head of Office, Forensic Science Laboratory, Rohini Sec-14, Madhuban Chowk, New Delhi on or before 23 October 2026. The selection process c

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

age_limit.details: The applicant shall not exceed 27 years or be below the age of 21 as on the last date of submission of application. Age relaxation for candidates belonging to the SC/ST category and for OBC Category will be applicable as per the prevailing Govt. Rules.

qualification.details: Post Qualification Required Chemistry Master’s degree in Chemistry or Toxicology or Biochemistry or Forensic Science with Chemistry as one of the subjects or papers during all the three years of Bachelor of Science level from a recognized university in Delhi. Biology Master’s degree in Zoology or Botany or Microbiology or Anthropology or Biology or Human Biology or Life Science or Biochemistry or Genetics or Biotechnology or Molecular Biology or Forensic Science with Zoology or Botany as one of the subjects or papers during all the three years of Bachelor of Science level from a recognized university in Delhi. OR B.E./B. Tech in Biotechnology from a recognized university in Delhi. Ballistics Master’s degree in Physics/ Mathematics/ Applied Mathematics /Forensic Science with Physics or Mathematics as one of the subjects papers during all the three years of Bachelor of Science level from a recognized university in Delhi. Cyber Forensic Master’s degree in Computer Science/ Computer Application/ Information Technology/ Physics with specialization in Electronics/Cyber Security from a recognized university in Delhi. OR B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering/Information Technology/Electronics & Communication Engineering/Electricals & Electronics Engineering from a recognized university in Delhi. Physics(A/V) Master’s degree in Physics or Applied Physics or computer science or electronics or Forensic Science with Physics as one of the subjects or papers during all the three years at B.Sc. level from a recognized university in Delhi. OR Bachelor of Engineering or B.Tech (Civil or Electrical or Mechanical or Electronics or Telecommunication or Computer Science or Instrumentation) or Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) or Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE) or Information Technology or Electronics or Electrical and Electronics (EEE) from a recognized university in Delhi.

how_to_apply: Download the application form and notification PDF from the official website fsl.delhi.gov.in.
Fill out the application form with your desired division for internship and personal details.
Affix a passport size photo on the designated space of the application form.

Enclose self-attested photocopies of degree, certificate, testimonials, and other relevant documents along with a self-attested identity proof (Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank pass book with photograph duly attested by a Nationalized Bank, or passport).
Superscribe the envelope containing the application form with "Application for engagement of Intern on stipend basis in (name of division)".

Submit the physically completed application form to the Head of Office, Forensic Science Laboratory, Rohini Sec-14, Madhuban Chowk, New Delhi-110085 either physically or through registered/speed post on or before 23.10.2026 upto 05:00 PM.

Fill out the application form with your desired division for internship and personal details. Affix a passport size photo on the designated space of the application form. Enclose self-attested photocopies of degree, certificate, testimonials, and other relevant documents along with a self-attested identity proof (Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhaar Card, Bank pass book with photograph duly attested by a Nationalized Bank, or passport). Superscribe the envelope containing the application form with "Application for engagement of Intern on stipend basis in (name of division)". Submit the physically completed application form to the Head of Office, Forensic Science Laboratory, Rohini Sec-14, Madhuban Chowk, New Delhi-110085 either physically or through registered/speed post on or before 23.10.2026 upto 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. Is this post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The engagement is on a contract basis for a period of one year on a stipend basis.

faq.question: Q2. Who gets an age relaxation and how much?
faq.answer: Age relaxation for candidates belonging to the SC/ST category and for OBC Category will be applicable as per the prevailing Govt. Rules.

faq.question: Q3. Who cannot apply for this internship?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already worked as a paid intern in FSL, Delhi shall not be eligible to apply.

faq.answer: Applicants must attach self-attested photocopies of degree, certificate, testimonials, and other relevant documents along with a self-attested ID proof such as a Driving License, Voter Card, Aadhaar Card, bank passbook with photograph attested by a nationalized bank, or passport.

faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 23.10.2026 up to 05:00 PM.
